[NDBG.10.1.2] A firing keeps one thread id for the whole session, and
the adapter must never give that id to another firing. A fork's firings
([NDBG.14.17]) get ids of their own. When a firing becomes a thread, the
adapter sends a `thread` event with `reason: "started"`, and when it stops
being one, a `thread` event with `reason: "exited"`.
